column4: \t\t傷付いたレイを会談の館内で倒す
column5: They defeat wounded Lei inside the conference hall.

column4: \t\t卑怯な・・と最初の奇襲で受けたカオスの傷が致命傷で倒れるレイ
column5: Cowardly... Lei falls, fatally wounded by Chaos's initial surprise attack.

column4: \t\tがはははは、勝利すればいいのよ。
column5: Hahaha, it's fine as long as we win.

column4: \t\t止めを刺して魔血魂にしてしまいます。
column5: We'll finish him off and turn him into a Demonic Blood Soul.

column4: \t\tカチューシャはいつの間にかいなくなっています。
column5: Katyusha has disappeared without anyone noticing.

column4: \t\tふん、裏切り者も逃げたか・・あの豊満ボディを拷問プレイで楽しもうと思ったのに残念
column5: Hmph, the traitor escaped too... I was looking forward to torturing that voluptuous body, what a shame.
